problem: A managed N.E.K.O patch can carry regression tests in its diff while the XiaoYu patched-product cloud gate or local release gate forgets to execute any test from that touched file, allowing product acceptance to drift away from the patch itself.

reuse_order.result: N.E.K.O provides the underlying tests, but cannot know XiaoYu's private managed-patch series or which private product gates must replay them.
Latest upstream main equals current pin c3fc33ff0d32e4a79fd905d1add22d45725071f5; no private-overlay patch/test manifest integration exists.

reuse_order.layer: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK / PluginStore / NekoClaw / MCP / native delivery
reuse_order.result: Not an execution-plane extension problem; these surfaces must not become a second test registry.
Existing pytest, Node test runner and GitHub Actions remain execution mechanisms; no new test framework or CI service is needed.
Generic coverage/CI tooling cannot infer the semantic relationship between XiaoYu's private patch series and the two product acceptance segments without an explicit local manifest rule.

Reuse series.json, patch diff headers and the existing overlay contract test file. Enforce only that every test file touched by a managed patch is represented in both cloud patched-product and local release segments; targeted node IDs remain allowed.
Reject a new tool, test registry, daemon, state store, router, workflow framework or patch metadata database.

acceptance_contract.cloud_segment_end: Verify pinned native Execution Plane seams

acceptance_contract.extraction: For each patch named by series.json, parse diff headers matching tests/** and require each touched test basename in both acceptance segments.
acceptance_contract.zero_test_patch_policy: A managed patch that touches no tests is not fabricated into coverage; existing patch evidence/reuse gates remain responsible for its acceptance record.
acceptance_contract.targeted_test_policy: A basename may be represented by a targeted pytest node ID; the invariant deliberately does not force complete upstream test files into every push.
